prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT mockup for Hans Santos, a personal client-services portfolio. Flat frontal website viewport, 1536x1024 landscape. No browser bezel or device frame. Direction explicitly approved: Editorial engineering studio. Warm ivory #F7F5EF background, near-black #222321 body text, cobalt #2449DD accent, generous whitespace, simple near-square controls, no shadows, no gradients, no generic decorative art. Clean modern humanist geometric sans (Manrope-like) throughout; absolutely no serif or monospace. Normal-case labels. The website's sequence is introduction, services, selected projects, working approach, contact. This mockup shows introduction + all four services and the beginning of selected projects. This is a client portfolio, no invented clients, testimonials, metrics, portrait, credentials, stock hardware imagery, or fake project screenshots. Use only semantic text and flat UI controls. First viewport must be striking through typographic scale and whitespace; all text crisp and realistic. Header: left "Hans Santos." with a tiny cobalt square, right links "Services", "Work", "Contact". Intro small label "Developer & maker · Batangas, Philippines". Exact main heading "Your idea,\nbuilt to work." with the second line cobalt. Intro body exact: "Websites, apps, electronics, and embedded systems. I’m Hans Santos — I turn ideas into practical builds." Primary cobalt rectangular link "Let’s talk about your project" with small northeast arrow. Secondary plain link "Explore the work". Services heading "What I can help you build". Four offers with exact titles and supporting copy: "Web development" / "Custom websites with clear interfaces."; "App development" / "Applications shaped around your workflow."; "Electronics engineering" / "Circuits and electronic prototypes."; "Embedded systems" / "Firmware that connects software and hardware.". Bottom beginning of next section: label "Selected work" and title "A few things I’ve built." No plus icons, no fake charts, no diagrams or images in this viewport. No fourth competing accent.
Composition C: structured studio index. Header y48 margin76. Intro two-column: left 72% heading huge at y175 same two lines; right 23% supporting paragraph and cobalt CTA stacked at y250. Services at y600, left 34% section title; right66% FOUR HORIZONTAL TEXT ROWS, each ordinal, service name, short explanation, and tiny northeast icon, separated by subtle neutral hairlines. Rows remain airy with 72px height, no boxed cards. Selected work title begins y975. Elegant asymmetry, editorial index feel, service list readable at a glance.
approval: Choice delegated through explicit autonomous LFG invocation; root selected composition C after displaying all three within Hans's approved option 1.
